note: Hancock County park on US-60 between Hawesville and Lewisport: nearly 400 acres around a 19-acre fishing lake (trolling motors only) circled by a paved 1.1-mile walking trail, with playgrounds, disc golf, ballfields and courts. Staffed weekdays 7 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.; an answering machine takes calls after hours. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 21 sites with water/electric, dump, camping Apr 1-Oct 31 (now manual). No rate posted anywhere official; amperage and showers not stated by the county. Not waterfront holds. Note no longer says 'on the Ohio River'.
flags: WEBSITE: https://hancockishome.com/places/vastwood-park/ (chamber listing) -> suggest https://hancockky.us/departments/parks/vastwood-park/ (the county's own page) first, chamber page second.

INCLUSION EVIDENCE cites a 'camplinq booking page': camplinq.com/camps/vastwood-co-park is generated filler (cabins, indoor pool, a Hart's Camp Oregon FAQ), not a booking channel. No online booking exists; whether sites are reservable is not stated by the county (phone 270-927-8778, staffed weekdays only). Booking left unknown.

FEES: no official rate. The chamber page says 'See the information below for rates' but the rules PDF was never inserted; the county page posts none. Aggregator reports (Campendium 2022/2024) say $16-18 a night with electric - corroboration only, not written. Rate unknown.

HOOKUPS/FACILITIES UNCONFIRMED IN PART: county pages state water + electricity, a dump station and a 24-hour bath house, but no amperage (stored 50, from note prose) and no explicit showers (stored true). Left as derived.

WATERFRONT not waterfront: HOLDS. Leaf-off imagery: the RV pad block sits ~100 m from the lake behind two loop roads, the bathhouse lawn and a treed bank. A July 2026 Google review says 'love being right on the water' - probably one of the tent sites on the shore loop; a review can't carry a waterfront call, and no RV site is near the shore.
NOTE FIX: the old note put the park 'on the Ohio River'; the county places it on US-60 between Hawesville and Lewisport around its own lake (the Ohio is ~2 km north). Removed.
PIN 37.90800,-86.78660 sits ~55 m S of the RV pad block - fine. Google's pin (37.90654,-86.79124, ~450 m W) is the park entrance/beach house; do not move to it.
